from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u097/system/state/workspace/programs')

program_path=program_dir/'task-a8b5b6d3.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
        for r in range(h):
            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                if color == bg:
                    continue
                pr, pc = r - dr, c - dc
                if 0 <= pr < h and 0 <= pc < w and grid[pr][pc] == color:
                    continue
                run = []
                rr, cc = r, c
                while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == color:
                    run.append((rr, cc))
                    rr, cc = rr + dr, cc + dc
                if len(run) < 2:
                    continue
                for sr, sc in ((-dr, -dc), (dr, dc)):
                    rr, cc = (run[0] if sr == -dr else run[-1])
                    rr, cc = rr + sr, cc + sc
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and out[rr][cc] == bg:
                        out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr, cc = rr + sr, cc + sc
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path)
